args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. The site has a clean, simple design, which is great for a personal page. However, it's currently quite minimal — just a brief introduction and your email. I'd suggest adding more content, such as a short bio, your projects or interests, and maybe some photos or links to your work. This would give visitors a better sense of who you are and make the site more engaging. Overall, a nice start with plenty of room to grow!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. I love that your blog is centered around hiking — it's a wonderful hobby and a great theme for a personal blog! The site is simple and easy to read. To make it even better, I'd suggest adding some blog posts about your favorite trails, hiking tips, or photos from your adventures. That kind of content would really bring your passion for hiking to life and keep readers coming back. Keep up the great work!
